expectations.buyer: Maintenance engineers, field service, machine owners, safety teams, technical librarians, and OEM or distributor support
expectations.pain: A technician uses the wrong manual, revision, service bulletin, erratum, or machine-specific option record on legacy equipment
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM support portals and literature libraries, machine documentation packs, document management, distributors, service organizations, and archived local copies
expectations.biggestRisk: Copyright and access limits constrain aggregation, OEM serial/configuration context controls applicability, and search alone cannot authorize a maintenance action
